reference: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15026-2:2022 structural terminology; domain-specific safety/security/dependability rules still govern content quality
purpose: Represent an auditable bounded claim-argument-evidence case with explicit context, assumptions, defeaters and review state.
close_conditions: all material claims have at least one declared argument path
argument premises are linked to evidence or explicit assumptions
blocking defeaters are closed or force HOLD
control verification is distinct from control existence
configuration and validity envelope match the requested operation
acceptance authority is external to the assurance case itself
output_rule: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE is not certification, legal approval, custodial approval or execution permission.
